title: Autopay Terms for Home Comfort Financing Accounts
content:
Two plan figures govern autopay on a Home Comfort Financing account: the autopay APR reduction, in percentage points, and the number of returned autopay payments within 12 months after which autopay is removed.

| Plan | Autopay APR reduction | Returned autopay payments within 12 months that remove autopay |
|---|---|---|
| 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan | 0.00 points (none) | 2 |
| 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | 0.00 points (none) | 2 |
| 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | 0.00 points (none) | 2 |
| 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 0.25 points | 2 |
| 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 0.25 points | 2 |
| 144-Month 9.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 0.25 points | 2 |

## Points of reading

- The autopay APR reduction is stated in percentage points of APR, not as a percent of the APR: on the 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan, a reduction of 0.25 points moves 5.99% to 5.74%.
- The three promotional plans carry no autopay APR reduction (0.00 points).
- The removal figure is 2 returned autopay payments within 12 months on every plan.
